description_en: You can invoke GetUser to obtain the agent information corresponding to a specified agent ID under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用GetUser获取指定实例下指定坐席ID对应的坐席信息
kebab_example: aliyun ccc get-user --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --extension 80030000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetUser

parameters.help_en: Agent ID. This parameter is optional. You must specify either UserId or Extension
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID，选填，UserId和Extension任选一个填写即可
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Agent extension number. This parameter is optional. You must specify either UserId or Extension
parameters.help_zh: 坐席分机号，选填，UserId和Extension任选一个填写即可
parameters.name: extension
